About Me

Contact:

david@rudcreative.com

It started with a road trip. The summer I graduated high school, my five best friends and I piled into a car and drove for two weeks. I filmed the whole thing.

I cut the footage into a 20-minute documentary and posted it on YouTube. It got close to 100,000 views. That’s when I realized I had a gift for storytelling, and that I wanted to keep doing it.

So I kept going. Today I film for Syracuse Division I sports, make video for local businesses, and run my own production company, Rud Creative.

Next, I want to bring that same drive to advertising campaigns for major brands, at an agency.
